# Stripe MCP on Cursor

Connect Stripe data and tools to Cursor using the Stripe MCP Server

## Description

Cursor is an AI-powered code editor that integrates large language models directly into the development environment. Build, test, and scale Stripe integrations faster with AI-driven assistance directly in Cursor with Stripe MCP. Connecting to the Stripe MCP server will supercharge Cursor’s agent capabilities, by allowing you to access your Stripe data and perform actions on your Stripe account from within Cursor itself.

## Instructions

There are two ways to install the Stripe MCP server in Cursor: 1. Click on the Install in Cursor button from the Stripe MCP docs (https://docs.stripe.com/mcp#connect)

![Feature image](https://stripe-camo.global.ssl.fastly.)
2. Open up Cursor Settings > Tools & MCP > Add Custom MCP

![Feature image](https://stripe-camo.global.ssl.fastly.)
Add the following to your mcp.json file { "mcpServers": { "stripe": { "url": "https://mcp.stripe.com" } } }
